beats.title: PR Merged After Contributor Exceeded Original Scope
beats.body: The PR was merged on 2022-03-25 after the contributor voluntarily extended the implementation beyond the originally scoped partial support to include the full second-order derivative path. The maintainer found only a single minor nitpick, applied it directly, and merged immediately, praising the contribution as a model of high-quality open-source work.

beats.title: Engineering Lessons
lessons: Scoping a complex feature incrementally lets reviewers build trust before a contributor expands to the full solution voluntarily.
Detailed mathematical derivations in a PR description dramatically reduce review friction and serve as lasting documentation for future contributors.
A maintainer who merges quickly after a minor self-applied fix signals that review velocity is a form of respect for contributor effort.
